summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as keyword-triggered rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/: ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py and ServiceFargate.py. Added three matching test modules under test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. All 73 ECS tests pass, and the wider test/unit/rules suite plus the rules-collection test passes (989 tests). Tests were run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this checkout's src, because the venv's cfnlint resolves to its base/ tree. Nothing was committed and the venv was not modified. Black and ruff are not in the venv, so formatting was checked by line length only (all lines are 88 columns or fewer) and one signature was fixed by hand. Design choices: E3052 emits at most one error per service and task-definition pair; E3053 evaluates port mappings per NetworkMode branch and compares HostPort and ContainerPort within the same branch; booleans are skipped as unknown values; the small reference-name helper is duplicated in E3052 and E3054.
